high_level_description: The image is a page from a book or article discussing the genetic basis of complex behavior in bumble bees and their interaction with a protozoan parasite. The text is divided into two sections: Top Section: The text discusses a genetic demonstration involving bumble bees. It mentions that only bees with both mutated genes were capable of uncapping cells and removing diseased pupae. This is described as an early demonstration of the genetic basis of complex behavior. Middle Section: The text introduces another story about the battle between bumble bees and one of their microscopic parasites.
